name: Caver Dermot

intro.text: A wee stalactite for the mantelpiece, that's all I'm after! Nobody'll miss one. Get out of my light!

win: All right, all right! I'll leave them be. They're nicer where they are, to be fair.
after: I've put the hammer away. Turns out a stalactite grows about the width of a fingernail in a lifetime. Mine would've taken ten thousand years to replace.
